name: track_then_log
title: First day · "track what I eat" gets a table at once, and "log two eggs" a row

steps.reply:
I've set up a **Food** module with a **Food log** table. It's empty for now.

Each entry holds:
- the food
- when you ate it
- the meal (breakfast, lunch, dinner, snack or drink)
- the quantity
- calories
- protein, carbs and fat
- notes

Tell me what you ate, for example "two boiled eggs and toast for breakfast", and I'll add it. I'll look up calories and macros from a source I can name where I can. Anything I have to estimate will be marked as an estimate, and I'll tell you any portion size I assumed.

I haven't set a calorie goal. If you want one, say so and I'll record it.

I logged two eggs at 20:32 today: about 144 kcal, 12.6 g protein, 0.8 g carbs and 9.6 g fat.

These numbers are estimates, not from a label. I assumed large eggs cooked without added fat, and I left the meal blank. If they were boiled, fried or a different size, tell me and I'll correct the entry.
